title: Aviation visual sequencing
description: A passenger jet unexpectedly loses thrust at altitude. The captain and first officer recognize the problem, diagnose the aircraft state, manipulate the controls, coordinate a response, stabilize the descent, and prepare the aircraft for an emergency landing. Treat the Pictures as visual references for a fictional sequence; do not identify real people or assert historical events.

story.sequenceContext: A twin-engine passenger jet is in flight with the same two flight crew members, cockpit environment, aircraft appearance, weather and daylight conditions throughout the emergency.
